== Acquisition ==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
*[[Factions]]
**[[Blade Ancient Syu-Shai]] ([[Raisu Palace (explorable area)]]) (requires a party member to be carrying a [[Proof of Triumph]])

Note that as a [[List of PvE-only skills|PvE-only]] skill, [[Elite Skill Tome|Elite Skill Tomes]] cannot be used to learn this skill.

== Notes ==
* Shadow Theft can buff itself. This can be done at rank 16 by casting it just as it recharges, raising the duration to 25s and attribute increase to 6.
* The attribute reduction effect persists if the caster dies.
* With at least rank 14 [[Critical Strikes]], Shadow Theft will push the Critical Strikes attribute over rank 18 which is the threshold to gain 4 energy per [[critical hit]].
* This skill only increases the primary profession's [[primary attribute]] and primary and secondary profession's [[secondary attribute]]s, it doesn't increase attributes obtained through [[blessing]]s or [[Seven Weapons Stance]].

== Trivia ==
* This skill uses an altered version of the icon from the ''[[Guild Wars 2]]'' [[GW2:thief|thief]] utility skill [[gw2:Shadowstep|Shadowstep]].
* Unlike most assassin skill icons, which depict red elements on purple background, this icon has a purple silhouette on a red background.
* Added to the game with the [[Feedback:Game updates/20200422|22nd April 2020 update]] as part of the 15th [[Anniversary Celebration]].
